scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is Hakone Turnpike and Skyline, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 14 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

tokyo-hakone-turnpike-and-fuji-lakes-and.story: A one-way ride of 515 km, Odawara to Atami - roughly 9 h 20 in the saddle. On the way it passes Hakone Turnpike, Lake Ashi view, Fuji Five Lakes  window and Atami  and coast. The climb of the day is Izu Skyline high road. It tops out at about 1,050 m. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
